// Optional preparation only. No telemetry export, SDK, or Pulse dependency.
package main

import (
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	metrics "go.opentelemetry.io/proto/otlp/collector/metrics/v1"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/encoding/protojson"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/proto"
	"math"
	"os"
	"strconv"
)

func main() {
	input, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[1])
	must(err)
	var request metrics.ExportMetricsServiceRequest
	must(proto.Unmarshal(input, &request))
	body, err := (protojson.MarshalOptions{UseEnumNumbers: true}).Marshal(&request)
	must(err)
	must(os.WriteFile(os.Args[2]+".google", body, 0600))
	// OTLP/JSON differs from generic ProtoJSON: enum numbers (above), and hex
	// trace/span IDs rather than base64. Preserve the unadapted input separately.
	var object any
	must(json.Unmarshal(body, &object))
	ids(object)
	body, err = json.Marshal(object)
	must(err)
	must(os.WriteFile(os.Args[2], body, 0600))
	// Actual Go fixed shortest-roundtrip spelling, including boundaries/subnormals.
	bits := []uint64{0, 1, 0x8000000000000000, 0x0010000000000000, 0x7fefffffffffffff,
		0x3ff0000000000000, 0x3fb999999999999a, 0x44b52d02c7e14af6}
	state := uint64(0x123456789abcdef)
	for i := 0; i < 2048; i++ {
		state ^= state << 13
		state ^= state >> 7
		state ^= state << 17
		bits = append(bits, state)
	}
	cases := []map[string]string{}
	for _, b := range bits {
		f := math.Float64frombits(b)
		if math.IsNaN(f) || math.IsInf(f, 0) {
			continue
		}
		cases = append(cases, map[string]string{"bits": fmt.Sprintf("%016x", b), "label": strconv.FormatFloat(f, 'f', -1, 64)})
	}
	body, err = json.Marshal(cases)
	must(err)
	must(os.WriteFile(os.Args[3], body, 0600))
}
func ids(value any) {
	switch v := value.(type) {
	case map[string]any:
		for k, item := range v {
			if k == "traceId" || k == "spanId" {
				raw, err := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(item.(string))
				must(err)
				v[k] = hex.EncodeToString(raw)
			} else {
				ids(item)
			}
		}
	case []any:
		for _, item := range v {
			ids(item)
		}
	}
}
func must(err error) {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
